_comment: Data periods for dashboards the metrics pipeline does not describe.
The five headline dashboards (CPI, GDP, Labour Force, Household Income,
Population) get their period automatically from keyPenangMetrics via the
'Penang at a glance' cards. This file covers dashboards outside that set.
Every value here was read from the live Google Sheet the pipeline writes,
not typed from memory. 'source' records where, so the next person can
re-check it rather than trust it. Re-read them when they look stale.
Deliberately ABSENT, because their transform produced no rows in the
2026-09-20 pipeline run and a date would therefore be a claim we cannot
support: gender, property, graduates. Also absent: manf and finance,
